about_the_game:
Welcome to Camp Manager Simulator — the ultimate camping business experience!

Have you ever dreamed of running your own campground? In Camp Manager Simulator, you start small, managing a modest patch of land, and slowly grow it into a bustling outdoor paradise. From pitching the very first tents to developing large-scale facilities, every decision you make shapes the future of your campsite. Your goal is simple: keep your campers happy, expand your grounds, and build the most successful campground business in the wilderness!

🌲 Build & Expand

Design your campsite the way you want. Place tents, cabins, bungalows, and caravans in strategic spots to maximize space and attract different types of visitors. Expand your territory by purchasing land beyond your fences, opening up new areas such as forest trails, lakeside views, and scenic hilltops. Every expansion offers fresh opportunities and new challenges.

😀 Keep Campers Happy

Your campers aren’t just faceless NPCs—they have personalities, preferences, and stories. Some will share funny dialogues by the campfire, while others might come as families, groups of friends, or adventurous solo travelers. Satisfy their needs with clean facilities, fun activities, and cozy spots to relax. Happy campers mean better reviews, more income, and a stronger reputation.

💰 Manage the Business

Running a campsite isn’t only about nature—it’s about numbers too. Balance your finances, rental rates, and upkeep costs. Decide whether you’ll rent spaces directly to campers or set up your own ready-to-use facilities. Hire staff, manage supplies, and make sure everything runs smoothly. The more efficiently you manage, the more your profits and possibilities grow.

🎉 Activities & Events

Open new activity areas to keep your visitors entertained. Build campfires, fishing spots, hiking trails, sports areas, or even festival stages. Organize seasonal events like summer BBQs, night markets, or music evenings to attract more guests. Special events not only bring in revenue but also give your campsite a unique personality.

🌦️ Dynamic Environments

Experience the beauty of nature with day-night cycles and weather changes. Mornings by the lake, sunny afternoons in the forest, rainy evenings in the cabins, and starry nights by the fire all bring your campsite to life. Adapt your management strategies depending on the conditions—rainy days may lower campfire attendance, while sunny weekends bring crowds flooding in.

🛠️ Customize & Personalize

Shape your campground’s identity! From decorative elements like benches, lanterns, and pathways, to larger structures such as bridges, docks, and playgrounds, customization lets you make your campsite truly yours. Will you run a rugged, back-to-basics wilderness retreat or a luxurious glamping resort? The choice is yours.

🔑 Key Features

  • Build and expand your own campsite, from tents to luxury bungalows.

  • Rent spaces to NPC campers or prepare your own facilities.

  • Manage finances, staff, and resources to grow your business.

  • Dynamic NPC groups with unique dialogues and personalities.

  • Open activity zones and host special events.

  • Day-night cycle and weather system that affect gameplay.

  • Deep customization options for layouts and decorations.

  • Grow from a humble campground into a full outdoor empire.

Camp Manager Simulator combines the charm of the great outdoors with the challenge of management gameplay. Whether you’re carefully balancing your budget, watching NPCs laugh around the fire, or planning your next big expansion, every moment brings you closer to becoming the ultimate campground tycoon.

Are you ready to pitch your first tent and build the campground of your dreams? Add your whistlist!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
